understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly matched that goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move cost one stamina, and reaching zero stamina consumed a life before restoring stamina. Walls blocked movement, so the blocked_directions list had to be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers advanced colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers turned the piece 90 degrees clockwise. A goal activated only when all three piece attributes matched its requirements, and stepping onto an activated goal completed it and advanced the game once all goals in the level were finished.
